description: Na₂Ti₂O₅ is Chalcostibite-like structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.56 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with five TiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one TiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.61 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to four O atoms to form TiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, corners with three TiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.86 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to four O atoms to form TiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids and corners with three TiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.87 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Ti atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Ti atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Ti atoms.
